subject: Human Body
title: How Muscles Grow
description: A short lesson to help you apply How Muscles Grow.

hook.text: Lifting weights tears muscle fibers at a microscopic level. Growth happens when the body repairs the damage.

buildup.text: Satellite cells fuse with damaged fibers, adding material. The repaired fiber becomes thicker and stronger.

discovery.text: This is hypertrophy: muscles don't get more fibers, they get bigger fibers. Cell count stays roughly the same.

twist.text: Growth happens during rest, not during exercise. Train without recovery and muscles break down instead.

climax.text: Protein provides the building blocks. Without enough dietary protein, repair stalls no matter how hard you train.

punchline.text: Break the fibers, feed them, rest them. That's growth.

quiz.question: When does muscle growth actually happen?
options: During rest and recovery after exercise
